method: listening count: an audio model (gemini-3.8-flash, temperature 0.2) hears the whole clip and lists every sound effect it hears with its onset; the rate uses the file's own duration, not the model's. Counts what a listener hears, not the cues placed (our v1 places 225).
spread_from: two runs on the kit-A mix of Hot Money r4: 35 and 29 effects in 90.1 s (23.3 and 19.3 a minute)
